name: aems-backend-v5
description: AEMS V5 Backend - ASP.NET Core 8 WebAPI

scripts.db-update: dotnet ef database update --project src/AEMS.Infrastructure --startup-project src/AEMS.Api
scripts.db-drop: dotnet ef database drop --project src/AEMS.Infrastructure --startup-project src/AEMS.Api

notes: 后端使用 .NET CLI 进行构建和运行。请确保已安装 .NET 8 SDK。
